1	# Task 11: Polished car-paint object with clearcoat on a turntable
2	
3	Framework: Aura3D (`@aura3d/engine`, already installed in node_modules).
4	
5	Build a single-page browser app with the provided framework, served by vite, drawing into the existing canvas with id #app. Show a glossy, candy-red, car-paint finished object on a slowly rotating turntable in a dark showroom. Since no model files are provided, construct the object procedurally from smooth shapes, for example a rounded, streamlined capsule or bean body with a separate smooth cabin bump and four dark rubber wheel discs, or any other smooth body with clearly curved, large reflective panels. The paint must look like automotive paint: a deep coloured base layer with fine metallic flake sparkle, topped by a glossy clear coat that mirrors a studio environment (long soft-box strip reflections that bend over the curved panels). Add chrome trim, such as a thin ring or strip, and a dark glass or black cabin panel for contrast. The turntable is a circular platform with a subtle ring light or reflective floor on which the object is mirrored faintly. Use a dark background with two or three long strip lights above and to the sides, plus a faint cool rim light, so the reflections read as soft-box highlights. The platform rotates the object at about 20 degrees per second while the camera stays still at a low, slightly front-three-quarter angle with the whole object in frame. 3	> Aura3D 5.0.2: a TypeScript SDK for browser 3D apps and games. You write a typed, declarative scene with `@aura3d/engine`; the `@aura3d/cli` toolchain handles typed GLB/glTF assets, checks and deploy gates. Built to be driven by AI coding agents. Site: https://aura3d.auraone.ai
4	
5	## Read first
6	
7	1. Coming from three.js? `docs/agents/threejs-to-aura3d.md` maps each three.js idiom to the Aura3D line (every line type-checked); the full table is in https://aura3d.auraone.ai/llms-full.txt under "three.js to Aura3D". Do not port renderer, resize, loop or disposal code: `createAuraApp` owns them.
8	2. No model admitted yet? Build it procedurally from `primitives.*`, `geometry.define`, `instances.*`, `material.*` and `environments.neutral`. Eight complete scenes (humanoid, terrain, props kit, PBR viewer, custom-shader water, sky and day/night, fire, night street with bloom) are `docs/agents/recipes.md` recipes 8 to 15, sources in `docs/agents/recipes-src/`.
9	3. Do not open `node_modules` or `dist` to find an API: signatures are in `docs/agents/api-signatures.md`.
10

12	
13	- Dark or flat frame: authored lights with no environment get no image-based light. Add `environments.neutral({ intensity })` or a `looks.preset(id)`; metals need it to reflect anything.
14	- Colour applied twice: instance `colors` multiply the material colour. Use a `#ffffff` base material when you pass `colors`.
